items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Don't you think it hurt Edmund Hall? Sure, Louis gave him some work and all that...

ctx.x: Well, I just name one. Don't you think it hurt Edmund Hall? Sure, Louis gave him some work and all that, but don't you think it hurts -- okay, take me. I look on the polls and I don't see my name on there, time after time after time. It never appears. And for the longest time, I wasn't even in the Who's Who in Jazz that was put out.
Who's Who? Well, Teo was putting it out.
